boundary: Original content to be authored. This inventory contains concept metadata and original authoring briefs, not a copy of course text or a quiz bank.

chapters.outcome: Variables, text, numeric expressions, and the run/debug cycle.
chapters.note: Use small, independent examples; supplementary input needs a real stdin prompt.

chapters.outcome: Boolean logic, branching, and deliberate debugging.
chapters.note: Expected-error checkpoints must pass when the intended exception is observed. Supplement: match/case with case _ as the wildcard.

chapters.outcome: Create, update, inspect, slice, and sort lists.
chapters.note: Accept alternative correct transformations. Teach mutating methods versus returned values. Supplements: tuples and zip.

chapters.outcome: Bounded iteration, control statements, and comprehensions.
chapters.note: Stop must recover from infinite loops without freezing the interface.

chapters.outcome: Reusable behavior, arguments, scope, and returned values.
chapters.note: Test functions with several inputs rather than comparing one printed example. Supplements: lambda and map.

chapters.outcome: Additional independent practice on decisions, lists, loops, and functions.
chapters.note: Optional groups never block required progression. Each challenge uses new scenarios and tests.

chapters.outcome: Indexing, immutability, searching, splitting, joining, and formatting.
chapters.note: Explain Unicode text and immutability accurately; test empty strings and absent markers.

chapters.outcome: Standard-library imports and local Python modules.
chapters.note: Bundle datetime, random, decimal, and custom-file import support. Environment management is conceptual reading.

chapters.outcome: Build, modify, query, and iterate mappings.
chapters.note: Teach insertion order, hashability, missing-key behavior, and dynamic dict views accurately.

chapters.outcome: Work with text, CSV, and JSON in a local virtual workspace.
chapters.note: Provide fixture tabs, generated-file inspection, deterministic reset, and downloadable output.

chapters.outcome: Create objects with state, behavior, and readable representations.
chapters.note: Verify behavior of multiple independent instances; avoid exact address-based repr checks.

chapters.outcome: Further practice with strings, dictionaries, and classes.
chapters.note: Keep challenges small; exclude separate portfolio/project assignments.

chapters.outcome: Review progress and select further study topics.
chapters.note: Provide an offline recap and optional external resource links; no required internet actions.

exercises.authoringBrief: Introduce the three panes and let the learner run a prepared status message.
Annotate a short weather-report script without changing its output.
Print a departure-board heading and inspect the terminal.
Represent a station name with valid quoted text.
Store a destination and use it in an output statement.
Find and repair a broken quotation mark in a message.
Represent a passenger count and a measured distance.
Calculate a journey duration using several arithmetic operations.
Update a score after successive events and inspect intermediate values.
Calculate storage capacities using exponentiation.
Distribute items among containers and report the remainder.
Assemble a short route label from independent strings.
Update an energy counter with augmented assignment.
Build a readable multiline bulletin.
Produce a compact equipment label using text and numeric variables.

quiz.inspection: Complete attempt, results, and retake tested

exercises.authoringBrief: Trace how a small program chooses between alternatives.
Distinguish objectively testable conditions from subjective descriptions.
Compare IDs and compute named Boolean results.
Distinguish Boolean values from similar-looking strings.
Show a warning only when a sensor crosses a threshold.
Apply inclusive and exclusive capacity limits.
Require two conditions before allowing a fictional machine to start.
Trigger a reminder when either of two maintenance conditions applies.
Express the opposite of an availability condition.
Produce one of two route messages.
Classify measured values with an ordered if/elif/else chain.
Provide an optional playground that combines decisions and Boolean logic.
Explain reproduce, inspect, change, and rerun with a small example.
Run a malformed conditional, inspect the traceback, and repair its syntax.
Observe an undefined-name error and repair inconsistent naming.
Observe an incompatible operation and choose an explicit conversion.
Summarize how error type, line number, and message guide a fix.

exercises.authoringBrief: Store a sequence of trail checkpoints.
Represent a small record containing text, numbers, and a Boolean.
Prepare a collection for incoming measurements.
Explain object.method(arguments) with a visible before-and-after example.
Add items to a packing list and inspect its order.
Combine two independent schedules without mutating the originals.
Retrieve selected entries from an ordered route.
Retrieve the final and penultimate readings.
Correct a mistaken entry at a known position.
Remove a canceled item and explore duplicate values and missing-value errors.
Create a small table of equipment and quantities.
Select a cell using row and column indexes.
Update a cell without replacing the surrounding table.
Maintain a compact stock table through several independent edits.

exercises.authoringBrief: Preview the operations needed to maintain an ordered collection.
Insert a new checkpoint before an existing one.
Remove and retain an item using pop.
Generate numbered workstations from a range.
Generate a stepped schedule and explain the excluded stop value.
Compare counts before and after edits, including nested collections.
Select a consecutive segment of a route.
Retrieve a prefix, suffix, and interior segment.
Count repeated status codes.
Sort numeric and text lists and inspect the original object and return value.
Create a ranking while preserving the input order.
Transform and inspect a small event queue with the operations learned.

exercises.authoringBrief: Explain repetition as a way to apply a rule to many inputs.
Compare repeated print statements with one loop.
Print a labeled line for every sensor.
Perform a fixed number of repetitions.
Advance a counter until a stopping condition becomes false.
Process a collection using a changing index.
Show how a missing state change causes a loop to run forever; support Stop.
Stop searching after a matching event is found.
Ignore invalid entries while continuing the remaining work.
Traverse a grid and build a running total.
Transform raw measurements into a new list.
Filter and transform a collection with a readable comprehension.
Process a small set of sensor batches using iteration and filtering.

exercises.authoringBrief: Explain reusable behavior with inputs and outputs.
Replace repeated formatting steps with a reusable operation.
Create a named function with an indented body.
Invoke a function several times and inspect execution order.
Debug which statements belong inside a function.
Turn a fixed message into a function that accepts a label.
Compute a delivery estimate from several inputs.
Call one function using all three supported argument styles.
Combine standard functions with a small custom helper.
Contrast local names with names available outside the function.
Return a result and use it in another expression instead of only printing.
Return and unpack a summary tuple.
Compose short helpers into a compact measurement summary.

exercises.authoringBrief: Represent and inspect a short location code.
Access characters while clearly distinguishing strings from lists.
Extract a segment from a structured label.
Construct a display label from several fragments.
Use string length to calculate slice boundaries.
Extract characters relative to the end.
Observe why item assignment fails and build a replacement string.
Include quotes and a line break in a message.
Examine characters individually in a loop.
Count characters matching a specified rule.
Check for a substring using in and not in.
Build and inspect a short formatted identifier.

exercises.authoringBrief: Explain that string methods return new values.
Normalize inconsistent labels while preserving originals.
Turn a line of words into a list.
Parse a simple delimited tag sequence.
Separate rows and columns from a small text sample.
Combine a sequence of words into a line.
Create a display path from independent fragments.
Clean leading and trailing whitespace and explain character-set stripping.
Update repeated markers in a template.
Find a marker and handle the -1 result for absence.
Fill positional slots in a status message.
Fill named slots from explicit values.
Clean and summarize a compact text log through several transformations.

exercises.authoringBrief: Use datetime and explain module-qualified names.
Generate sample values and select an item from a collection.
Use a readable alias and identify the name introduced by an import.
Compare floating-point behavior with Decimal constructed from strings.
Put a helper in a second Python file and import it from the main script.
Summarize standard-library, selected-name, alias, and local-file imports.

exercises.authoringBrief: Represent settings as named values.
Create a compact mapping of equipment IDs to counts.
Observe an unhashable-key error and choose a valid key type.
Initialize a mapping for future observations.
Build a small mapping incrementally and inspect each result.
Merge a batch of settings with update.
Change one value while preserving other entries.
Pair two sequences using zip and create a mapping.
Build and amend a nested catalog from independent input collections.

exercises.authoringBrief: Create and extend a short configuration mapping.
Retrieve named measurements from a mapping.
Observe KeyError, guard the lookup, and add the missing entry.
Read an optional setting with get and an explicit default.
Remove entries while retaining their values and handle absent keys.
Iterate keys and contrast a dynamic view with a list snapshot.
Aggregate numeric mapping values.
Unpack key-value pairs during iteration.
Move selected entries between collections and print a compact summary.

exercises.authoringBrief: Read a bundled station notice using a context manager.
Process each line of a small log.
Read successive lines and recognize end-of-file.
Create a new report and inspect the generated file.
Append a log entry and preserve previous contents.
Refactor manual file handling into a with block.
Inspect a small structured text fixture before parsing it.
Use DictReader and access fields by header name.
Parse a semicolon-separated file without splitting quoted fields manually.
Write a header and a sequence of records with DictWriter.
Load a nested configuration and access one setting.
Serialize a Python data structure and inspect the generated file.
Summarize modes, context managers, and structured file formats.

Declare a minimal class for a weather sensor.
Instantiate the class and store the resulting object.
Identify the class and type of an instance.
Define shared metadata and distinguish it from per-instance state.
Add behavior to a class using self.
Define a method that computes a result from explicit inputs.
Initialize a new object using __init__.
Give two instances distinct readings.
Use hasattr and getattr safely on varied objects.
Store state in the initializer and use it in later method calls.
Inspect attributes with dir and explain that functions are objects too.
Implement __repr__ for a useful diagnostic display.
Model sensors and their readings with two cooperating classes.
